installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Node.js + yt-dlp installation script
apt update
apt -y --no-install-recommends install git curl ca-certificates unzip tar

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "Assuming user knows what they are doing, skipping git clone."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Repository sudah ada, melewati clone."
    exit 0
fi

if [ ! -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    if [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
        GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
    fi

    if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        echo -e "Menggunakan anonymous clone."
    else
        GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
    fi

    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
        git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

echo -e "Instalasi selesai."
exit 0
